Canonical strategy_workshop target is accepted by schema and Governance public API; BFF projection preserves it; Workshop create derives strategy_id from authoritative Registry readback while retaining registry id; research/conclude now require exact tenant, owner, target type, workshop id, and version plus a distinct approver. Verification after rebase: 174 passed, 5 skipped. Evidence: docs/deployment/evidence/agora/ag-gov-workshop-contract-001/README.md. Hosted exact-pair requalification remains post-merge work and is not claimed here.

Review failed at pushed f59200906 / merged PR #4036 (merge 0346b28790d9534cfff76625caeadee8d5ea13b8): acceptance requires Workshop research/conclude to accept only a decided approval, but _require_approval uses 'if state and ...' and therefore accepts a missing state, and it also accepts noncanonical state/outcome aliases. Reviewer reproduction against the existing public router harness: approval with state removed returned HTTP 202 and a completed research dispatch; outcome='accepted' also returned HTTP 202/completed. Make the gate fail closed on exact canonical decision_state/state='decided' and canonical outcome in {'approved','approved_with_conditions'}, add negative coverage for both research and conclude proving no downstream dispatch/conclusion for missing/non-decided state and noncanonical outcome, and update the task evidence. Other verification passed: py_compile; focused suite 174 passed, 5 skipped; git diff --check; PR CI green.
